description.description: The body as tiptap JSON. Only the webapp uses this field.

parentId.description: Send null to move the page to the root.

entryPolicy.description: How the page controls new entries. On each policy, the server refuses a repeat of a known entry. On a CURATED page, each token has a limit of PROPOSED entries. An OPEN page has no such limit. On a LOCKED page, only people can write entries.
entryPolicy.title: PageEntryPolicyEnum

kind.description: People write AUTHORED pages. The server builds a GENERATED page from the entries that each section cites.
kind.title: PageKindEnum

question.description: The question of a GENERATED page. A change rebuilds the page.
